messages.author: 5140016d70f6ba82
messages.subject: Re: MRDS error
parts:
It looks as if it may be trying to write a file in a directory for which
you do not have write access. Are you an administrator on your own
machine? If so, you should be able to write anywhere unless you have
set the directory to read only. I wrote the mrds R package but Len
wrote the code that drives it from DISTANCE and that is where the error
is, so he'll have to address that. It appears that the directory
portion of filespec for the wmf file is missing but maybe that is
because the default directory is the dst4998 temp sub-directory. Len
may have to answer this one for you.

--jeff
